title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
claim_supported: Community-based graph summaries improve evaluated global sensemaking dimensions.
limitation: Two approximately million-token corpora; not universal accuracy or temporal validation.

title: RAG vs. GraphRAG: A Systematic Evaluation and Key Insights
claim_supported: Benefits depend on task, context budget, graph construction, and evaluation method.
limitation: Token matching narrows some gains; model judges show position bias.

title: BEIR: A Heterogenous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
claim_supported: Heterogeneous retrieval evaluation supports retaining lexical and reranking baselines.
limitation: Historical systems; retrieval metrics do not establish answer or forecast correctness.

title: Graphiti implementation
claim_supported: Implementation provides temporal edge fields, incremental ingestion, and hybrid retrieval.
limitation: Mutable main was reviewed without a pinned revision; documentation performance claims were not used as evidence.

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
claim_supported: Describes bitemporal memory and reports improvements over specified full-context baselines.
limitation: Vendor-authored evaluation; newer-information invalidation is unsuitable as an automatic scientific truth policy.

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
claim_supported: Evaluates retrieval, updates, temporal reasoning, multi-session reasoning, and abstention.
limitation: 500 questions; history setting, reader, and judge affect comparability.

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
claim_supported: Evaluates environment-specific state, workflows, gotchas, and premise awareness.
limitation: Prerecorded browser-agent histories; not online adaptation or all agent domains.

title: WildGraphBench: Benchmarking GraphRAG with Wild-Source Corpora
claim_supported: Heterogeneous evidence exposes differences between single-fact retrieval, aggregation, and summarization.
limitation: Wikipedia-derived reference claims and LLM judgments are imperfect ground truth.

title: RDF 1.1 Concepts and Abstract Syntax
claim_supported: Defines interoperable triples, graphs, datasets, and named graphs.
limitation: Atemporal data model; application-specific temporal semantics remain necessary.

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
claim_supported: Provides vocabulary for attribution, derivation, activities, and revisions.
limitation: Provenance does not certify truth, source independence, or uncertainty calibration.

title: Shapes Constraint Language
claim_supported: Validates RDF data against declared graph constraints.
limitation: Conformance is not factual correctness or causal identification.

title: Nanopublications: A Growing Resource of Provenance-Centric Scientific Linked Data
claim_supported: Claim-sized linked-data packages attach provenance and publication metadata.
limitation: Packaging and attribution do not validate assertions or resolve disagreements.
